summary: The sheet contains a 2nd floor alteration floor plan, basement alteration floor plan, general notes, keyed notes, and symbol legends. The plan identifies a new 45-minute F.P.S.C. door and new one-hour fire-resistive wall construction at stair-related work, with several references to other indexed sheets. No confirmed code violation is established from this sheet alone.

drafts.title: Accessibility standard basis should be coordinated with the adopted permit criteria
drafts.observation: General Note 4 identifies accessibility reach requirements using “ICC/ANSI A117.1-2003.” The sheet also includes notes concerning ADA-compliant hardware and door opening forces.
drafts.drawing_evidence: General Notes panel, Note 4: “ADJUST ALL SELF SERVICE ITEMS TO BE WITHIN ACCESSIBILITY REACH RANGE REQUIREMENTS (ICC/ANSI A117.1-2003).” General Notes panel, Note 5: “REPLACE OR ADD ADA COMPLAINT HARDWARE ON ALL DOORS ALONG ADA ACCESSIBLE ROUTE. SEE SHEET A-1.03 FOR SCHEDULE.”
drafts.drawing_location: Bottom-left General Notes panel, Notes 4 and 5
drafts.recommendation: Confirm that the accessibility standard identified in the general notes is consistent with the accessibility criteria used for this Washington, DC permit submission, and coordinate the final reach-range and door-hardware requirements with the referenced A-1.03 sheet.

drafts.title: Rated stair enclosure components require cross-sheet coordination
drafts.observation: The 2nd floor plan depicts stair-related work with a “NEW 45 MIN F.P.S.C. DOOR” and “NEW 1 HR. FIRE RESISTIVE WALL. SEE PARTITION D (THIS SHEET).” The plan also identifies metal-stud firestopping and references the door schedule on another sheet. This sheet alone does not establish continuity of the rated wall, door assembly, and adjoining construction.
drafts.drawing_evidence: At Stair Tower A on the 2nd floor plan: “NEW 45 MIN F.P.S.C. DOOR,” “NEW 1 HR. FIRE RESISTIVE WALL. SEE PARTITION D (THIS SHEET),” and a nearby wall note stating “4” METAL STUDS @ 16” O.C. MIN. FIRE STOPPED TO BOTTOM OF STRUCTURE AS PER UL NO. U305.” General Note 4 directs review of sheet A-6.00 for doors.
drafts.drawing_location: 2nd Floor Alteration Floor Plan, Stair Tower A area; lower General Notes panel
drafts.recommendation: Coordinate the rated door assembly and Partition D construction with the referenced A-6.00 door schedule and the applicable wall, head-of-wall, penetration, and stair-enclosure details on the indexed project sheets. Verify that the rating and firestopping provisions remain continuous at the shown interfaces.
